store.name: Sallam Apps
store.tagline: Home-made apps for family and friends.

apps.name: Wall Rush
apps.tagline: Race to the finish line and drop walls to block your rival.
apps.description:
A quick two-player board race. Every turn you choose: step closer to the finish line, or drop a wall in your rival's way. First one across wins.

Play against the computer or pass the phone to a friend.

apps.name: Da'im Stoppage Calculator
apps.tagline: See what machine stoppages cost a factory.
apps.description:
Enter a few numbers about a factory and see how much its machine stoppages cost each month and each year.

Don't know the numbers? Use the stoppage log: tap when a machine stops and when it runs again, and the calculator measures it for you. In English and Arabic.

apps.name: BarBee
apps.tagline: A training plan that tells you exactly what to beat next.
apps.description:
A week-by-week strength plan that is yours: put in your own name, your own training days and your own exercises, in kg or lb.

Each session shows the weight and reps to beat from last time, so you always know what counts as progress. Log a set with one tap and rest with the built-in timer.

It starts with an example week you can train as it is. Everything is saved on your own phone, and it works without internet once you have opened it.
